name: Sock Puppet Superstar
summary:
Sock Puppet Superstar is a VR rhythm music game where you perform live concerts using the most advanced musical instrument ever created: a sock on your hand.

Step into the spotlight and puppeteer your rising star. Lift your hand higher to belt the high notes, and lower it to go deep.

And the pressure is real. You're performing in a massive stadium packed with tens of thousands of screaming sock puppet fans who expect nothing less than greatness.
